title: Restaurant Assistant with Bedrock Knowledge Base
description: A restaurant assistant agent that helps customers make reservations and query restaurant information using Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base and DynamoDB

introBox.headline: How it works
text: Integrates with Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base and DynamoDB for restaurant information and bookings
Uses multiple tools including current_time, retrieve, create_booking, and booking management
Handles conversational flows with follow-up questions for natural interactions
Implements tool definitions using both decorator and TOOL_SPEC approaches
Provides local deployment option with AWS service integrations
